offerings.name: Web Search API (/search)
offerings.pricing: Credit-based: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results (rounded up). Free 1,000 credits/month ($0, 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped); Hobby $16/month billed yearly ($19 monthly) for 5,000 credits = 2,500 searches; Standard $83/mo annual (100,000 credits = 50,000 searches); Growth $333/mo; Scale $599/mo; Enterprise custom. Pay-as-you-go: Hobby 1,000 credits per $5, Standard 2,000/$5, Growth 2,500/$5, Scale 5,000/$5. Prices in USD, effective September 4, 2026.
offerings.price_basis: Hobby entry plan, $16/month billed annually, 2,500 searches/month (= $6.4 per 1,000 searches); monthly billing $19 = $7.6/1k; pay-as-you-go marginal rate on Hobby = 1,000 credits per $5 = $10/1k
offerings.free_quota: Free plan: 1,000 credits / month, $0, refreshed monthly, no credit card required — 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped, 2 concurrent requests, 10 req/min on /search
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（url、title、description、position，按 web / news / images / alexandria 分组），可用 scrapeOptions 一次调用同时返回每条结果的 markdown、HTML、links、screenshot；结果默认附带 query-relevant Highlights
offerings.note: 每 10 条结果 2 credits（向上取整），PDF 解析 +1 credit/页、JSON 模式 +4 credits/页；Enterprise ZDR：end-to-end 10 credits/10 results，anonymized 2 credits/10 results；/search 限速 Free 10/分、Hobby 100、Standard 500、Growth 5,000、Scale 10,000

offerings.name: Research Index / Developer Index (Search categories: research, developer)
offerings.pricing: The Firecrawl Research Index paper endpoints are free across every category, including AI/ML and life sciences.
offerings.free_quota: 免费（Research Index 论文检索端点在所有类别免费）
offerings.output_type: developer 类别返回标准 web 结果并带 category:"developer"；research 类别自 2026-11-16 起从 data.web 移到 data.research，返回论文记录：paperId、primaryId、ids、title、abstract、score
offerings.note: research 类别 2026-11-16 由“限定 14 个学术网站”切换为检索 Research Index（PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv、arXiv）；过渡期响应带 warnings 字段
